book.name: Mako
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Yesu akajendali kubhapwaghila, “Numpwaghi chakaka, bhabhi bhandu bhangi bhabhajemiki pambani, ambabhu ngabhipoteli ng'o, mbaka pabhaubhona Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ukahikaje kwa makili.”
Yesu ang'anambuka sula
Paghapetiki machobha sita, Yesu akabhatoliki Petulu, Yakobo na Yohana na kujenda nabhu kunani ja chitombi chikolongwa kanjika jabhu. Konihoku bhakumbweni akang'anambuka pamihu palongi jabhu,
ingobhu yaki ikang'anyiki, ikang'anyiki kupukupu nga mundu pundema joakaweza kwing'anyiha ngati bhenibhela.
Bhabhulwa bhatatu bhala bhakabhaweni Eliya na Musa bhakalongilaje na Yesu.
Petulu akumpwaghi Yesu, “Mbola, nde wichu tepani tubya pambane! Tuchengaje indamba itatu, chimu chaku, chimu chaka Musa na chengi chaka Eliya.”
Petulu na bhajaki bhakajowipi namaa, hata ngacheamanyi cha kulongela.
Bhela likapitali lihundi na kubhayeka, na sauti jakajowaniki kuhuma mu lihundi hele, “Hajoju nde Mwana wangu mpalu, munjowanya jombe!”
Palapala bhabhulwa bhaki bhakalingali kabheti, nambu ngachebhumbweni mundu jonge nambu Yesu kanjika jaki papamu na bheni pela.
Bhela pabhabhila bhahele pachitombi, Yesu akabhakanaki, “Ngabhumpwaghi mundu jokapi jola mambu ghabhaghaweni, mbaka Mwana waka Mundu paibya ayokiki kabheti.”
Bhela bhakalikamwi lilaghalaki hele, bhakatumbwi kulaluwana bheni kwa bheni, “Bho, kuyoka kwa bhabhapotile nde kike?”
Bhakundaluki Yesu, “Bho, mbona bhabhola bha Shelia bhapwagha Eliya anatumbula kuhika?”
Na jombi akabhayangiki, “Ena, Eliya anahika hoti kulenganake ghokapi. Hata bhela bho, maghambu ki ilembakiki mu Malembu Mahuhu kubha Mwana waka Mundu ahipata mang'ahiku ghamaheli na kuntondola?
Nambu numpwaghila, Eliya ajomwi kuhika na bhombi bhakuntendi ngati mobhapalila bheni ngati mokwalembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu panani jaki.”
Yesu andamiha nkombu joabhi na majobhi
Yesu na bhabhulwa bhangi bhatatu bhala, bhakakelawiki mbaka pabhakabhi bhabhulwa bhangi, bhakaliweni lipogha likolongwa la bhandu papo. Na bhabhola bhangi bha Shelia bhakabhi bhalochana nabhu.
Palapala lipogha la bhandu pabhakumbweni Yesu, bhakakangichi namaa, bhakunkembali nahuli bhundamukyaje.
Yesu akabhalaluki bhabhulwa, “Bho, ndochana nabhu kike?”
Panihapa mundu jumu pa lipogha la bhandu akayangike, “Mbola, nundetiki mwana wangu kwako, abhi na lijobhi leluntei abya mpuli.

Kila paghuntukalila, ghunhabhu pahi na kuntenda ghumpita mahuluhulu mundomu, koni akayagha minu ghaki na kujomangana hyegha joha. Nakabhajopiki bhabhulwa bhaku bhumboha lijobhi, nambu ngachebhawezike.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Mwanganya chibheleku changakubha na uhobhalelu! Bho, ananunhinakya mbaka lile? Mundeta nkombu wehoju kwangu nepani!”
Bhakumpeliki kwaka Yesu. Palapala lijobhi paakumbweni Yesu, akunjeghi mwana jola chihinduhindu, na mwana akaawiki pahi, akaghalawiki na kumpita mahuluhulu mundomu.
Yesu akundaluki tati waka mwana jola, “Hindu heyi yumpatiki kutumbu lile? Na jombi akamuyangiki, “Kutumbu umwana waki.
Na pamaheli lijobhi hoju angalawi nkombu hoju pamoto na mumachi, nahuli ankomaje. Henu, anauweza kuhenga lijambu lokapi lela, utubhonila chiha na utujangatyaje!”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Bho, maghambu ki upwagha ngati anauweza? Mambu ghokape ghaweza kuhengakeka kwaka mundu joahobhalela.”
Palapala, tati jola akaleliki kwa makili, “Nenga nhobhalela! Nambu uhobhalelu wangu nde kuchoko, unyangatya kuhobhalela nakanope.”

Yesu paakaliweni lipogha la bhandu lijonjukeka palongi jaki, akundakali lijobhi jola, “Lijobhi weuntenda mwana ajoju abya mpuli na ngajogwa, nukulaghalakila umboka mwana ajoju, na wala ngawanjingi kabhete!”
Palapala lijobhi lela lakajamalili, lakungalawi mwana jola pahi na lakumpitike. Mwana akabhonakini ngati joapotile na bhela bhandu bhangi bhakapwaghiki, “Apotile!”
Nambu Yesu akunkamwi chiwoku, akunjangati kujema, najombi akajemiki.
Bhela, Yesu paakajingi mu nyumba, bhabhulwa bhaki bhakundalukile, “Bho, maghambu ki tepani ngachetaweziki kulibhoha lijobhi lela?”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Majobhi gha bhenibhela ngacheghaweza kubhoka, nambu kwa indela ja kundobha Chapanga.”
Yesu alongale kabheti panani ja kupotela kwaki
Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakabhokiki panihapa, bhakajendali na mwanja kupete ku Galilaya. Yesu ngachepaliki bhandu bhamanya ngati abhi ku inchi jaki hoku,
maghambu akabhi abhabhola bhabhulwa bhaki. Akabhapwaghile, “Mwana waka Mundu anabhumpelaka kwa bhandu na bhombi anabhunkomaje, nambu lichobha la katatu anahyokaje.”
Nambu bhabhulwa bhaki ngachebhamanyi malobhi ghalongela, na bhakajowipi kundalukila.
Bho, joabhi nkolongwa nane?
Bhela, bhakahiki ku Kapelenaumu. Na paakabhi mu nyumba akabhalaluki, “bho, ndongalanya ki mwindela?”
Nambu bhombi ngachebhumpwaghile, ndandi pabhakabhi mwindela bhakalochini kubha nde nane nkolongwa pachilanda jabhu.
Yesu akatemi pahi, akabhalohiki komi na bhabheli, na kubhapwaghila, “Mundu anapahi kubha wa kutumbula, impalika akubhaje wa kujomukela na akubhaje mtumika wa bhokapi.”
Kabheti Yesu akuntohi mwana nchokuchoku, akunjemiki pachilanda jabhu, akunjobhatili na kubhapwaghila,
“Joanjopale mwana ngati jonjo kwa lihina langu, anyopale nepani, na joanyopale nepani, ngacheanyopale nepani pela, nambu anjopale jola joandumike.”
Mundu jokapi jwangakutupenga abhi upambala wito
Yohana akumpwaghi Yesu, “Mbola, tumbweni mundu jumu aghabhoha majobhi kwa lihina laku. Na tepani tukalengiki kunkanakila ndandi jombi ngacheabhi papamu na tepani.”
Nambu Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Ngamwankanakila, ndandi nga mundu joaweza kutenda ngangachu kwa lihina langu, na palapala kunongale mahakau.
Ndandi jwangakutupenga tepani abhi upambala wito.
Mundu jokapi jola joampekya chikombi cha machi gha kunywa, kwa kubha mabhanganya mabhandu bhaka Kristo, chakaka ngailepi kupata nhupu waki.
Malengakeku gha mahoku
“Mundu jokapi joanaantenda jumu wa bhachoku abhabha bhabhanhobhale nepani kuhenga mahoku, ikabya mbaka kwaka mundu hoju kukongakeka liganga likolongwa la kuyaghila na kulekaleka mubahali.
Chiwoku chaku anachikutendiki utendaje mahoku, hekataje! Mbanga kujingi mu womi panga chiwoku chimu, kuliku kubha na mabhoku ghabheli na kujenda ku Jehanamu, mu moto wangakuchuchuka.
Momuje, tundu twaki ngachetukuwa, wala moto waki ngacheuchuchuka.
Na chigholu chaku anachikutendiki utendaje mahoku, hekataje! Mbanga kujingi mu womi panga chigholu chimu, kuliku kubha na magholu ghokapi na kukujeghe ku Jehanamu, mu moto wangakuchuchuka.
Momuje, tundu twaki ngachetukuwa, wala moto waki ngacheuchuchuka.

Na lihu laku analukutendiki utendaje mahoku, litupulaje! Mbanga kujingi mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ukabya na lihu limu pela, kuliku kubha na mihu ghaku ghokapi ghabheli na kulekaleka mu moto wa Jehanamu.
Momuje tumbeku twaki ngachetukuwa, wala moto waki ngacheuchuchuka.
“Ndandi kila mundu anagholulikaji kwa mwinyu, ngati nyambiku mojigholulakela kwa moto.
“Mwinyu nde wamboni, nambu anauhoiki kunogha kwaki, bho, anaukolakika na kyane? “Mbya na mwinyu wa ukochi nkati jinu, na mkamulakyaje kutama kwa lukwale mabheti kwa mabheti.”
